verdict: Yes. Woman Like U pitched clothing designed for specific body types on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Fit is the biggest reason for returns in women's clothing, so a brand that solves fit can keep customers for years.
angle: Most brands grade one pattern up and down, which doesn't fit many real bodies. A brand built on body types, not just sizes, can cut returns and build loyalty. It needs careful pattern making and good education on how to choose a fit.
